rationale: B repeatedly shows clear, appropriate responses to inputs (touch→immediate excited lean-in at t8; call→orient/crouch to PERSON_ALPHA at t20; offer food→sustained focus on FOOD_TROUGH from t32; present ball→engaged play from t44; startle→lean-away/withdraw at t68 then recovery with renewed social focus and vocalizing at t78–83). B also initiates sensible shifts without prompts (to SHELTER at t18, to PERSON_BETA at t54, to PLAY_CHIME at t94) and maintains coherent, goal-directed engagement. A displays some self-initiated shifts early and orients to PERSON_ALPHA after call (t20), but after lying down at t36 remains largely unresponsive to PRESENT_OBJECT (t44) and STARTLE (t68), reducing adaptive responsiveness and overall aliveness.
